warnings: PNG contains two portrait ปร.4 sheets (A4, side by side, each rotated 90 degrees) combined into one A3-ish landscape scan (3309x2339px). Determined empirically (not assumed from another house) by cropping/rotating a height-based half first, which produced two partial rows of both sheets stacked — the real split is a WIDTH-based left/right cut at x=1428-1822 (a genuine blank gutter, confirmed via column ink-density scan), each half spanning the FULL original height, then rotated 90 deg clockwise to read correctly (90 deg counter-clockwise produced upside-down/mirrored text). This is the physical RIGHT half of the landscape scan, the lower-numbered sheet (แผ่นที่ 1/22 - สรุปงาน), paired with แผ่นที่ 2/22 (หมวดงานโครงสร้าง เริ่มต้น) extracted as _2.json. The same x=1428-1822 gutter was confirmed identical across all 11 source pages (67-77) via a batch column-ink-density scan before cropping any of them.

This is a blank ปร.4 summary/rollup template: all quantity, unit price, and amount cells for the 5 category rows and the grand-total row are empty in the source (no figures were ever filled in) - transcribed as null, not invented. This holds for every one of the 22 sheets in this document (all 11 assigned pages) - no unit price, amount, or grand total is stated anywhere in this BOQ.
Header fields ประมาณการโดย (estimator name), รายการเลขที่ and ประมาณราคาเมื่อวันที่ (estimate date) are also blank in the source.

Document is a 22-sheet ปร.4 BOQ book for this house's ฐานรากแผ่ (spread-footing) variant, 'บ้านต้านภัยพิบัติแผ่นดินไหว แบบ 2 ชั้น', แบบเลขที่ S 58175, AR58070, SN-58080, EE58196 - confirms this page range is the spread-footing BOQ variant per the task assignment (a second BOQ variant for the pile-footing design follows on later pages, out of scope here).

A small standalone page number '5' appears printed in the bottom-right corner of this half-sheet after rotation - this looks like a page number from the original compiled reference document distinct from this project's own png/doc_page numbering (same phenomenon documented on other houses' equivalent BOQ pages); doc_page here is derived as png-2 (67-2=65) by the same convention used on other houses' equivalent BOQ pages, not read directly off this small corner number - flagged since the true derivation rule for doc_page on BOQ pages has never been confirmed against this house's own front matter (out of this agent's assigned page range).

'58213' printed in the footer margin of every sheet in this document appears to be a compiled-catalog/print-batch code rather than a per-design code (an unrelated house's BOQ book was observed carrying the identical '58213' code) - transcribed verbatim, not investigated further as it is outside this assignment's scope.
